migrations.note: Index built first by running the file alone (CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY), then the ledger row was written by a DO block that refuses unless the index is valid/ready with the expected definition.

method: Supabase MCP execute_sql. V468/V469: one DO block per migration embeds the exact file text, refuses on md5/byte mismatch or an existing ledger row, comments out the file's BEGIN/COMMIT, EXECUTEs it and inserts the ledger row in the same transaction. V470: the file alone, then a guarded ledger DO block. Wrapper checks rehearsed on local Postgres 16 before apply.

attempts.detail: The Supabase MCP confirmation prompt expired unanswered five times (2026-11-05 evening, then about 11:34, 17:29, 17:39 and 17:45 VN on 2026-11-06); each time nothing ran and the read-only state was checked again before resending. The sixth send at 22:54 VN was approved.
attempts.v470ClientTimeout: The MCP client stopped waiting after 60 s; the server kept building (pg_stat_progress_create_index: index validation 84% at 70 s) and finished at about 100 s. Checked before writing the ledger row.
